items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And I had a course of philosophy with Dr. Balduff at the Central YMCA College.

ctx.x: And the same, same art you said. Yeah. And then the other was, when you came to Chicago, we have the Marquette up in Millenburg.

Well, I had, I had two years at Marquette where I had a course in public school music. And then I stood at Kimball Hall with Professor Manley, and I took my teacher's course on violin. Yeah. And I had a course of philosophy with Dr. Balduff at the Central YMCA College. Yes.
Now this is a conducting course under Lorenzo Teo.
